title: 冰水蓄冷與尖峰負載移轉
titleEn: Ice Thermal Storage and Peak Load Shifting
subcategoryTitle: 機械、壓縮空氣與熱儲能
summary: 大樓的冷氣是夏季用電尖峰的主因。儲冰空調在夜間電價便宜、電網輕載的時候啟動冷凍機，把水槽裡的水結成冰；白天需要冷氣時讓冰融化，冷凍機就可以少開或不開。紐約的美國銀行大樓在地下室裝了四十四座儲冰槽。課程定量分析潛熱蓄冷量與所需體積、製冰時的效率下降、移轉的電量與電費、需量費的節省、主機容量的縮減與電網層級的效益。
summaryEn: Air conditioning of large buildings is the main cause of summer demand peaks. Ice storage runs chillers at night, when power is cheap and the grid lightly loaded, to freeze water in tanks; by day the ice melts to supply cooling and chillers run less or not at all. The Bank of America Tower in New York has forty-four ice tanks in its basement. The course quantifies latent cold stored and volume needed, loss of efficiency in ice-making, energy and cost shifted, demand-charge savings, reduction in chiller size and benefit at grid level.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：冰水蓄冷與尖峰負載移轉
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Ice Thermal Storage and Peak Load Shifting
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潛熱蓄能」與「顯熱蓄熱量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Latent heat storage" and "Sensible heat storage": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「潛熱蓄能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Latent heat storage" is correct?
options: 物質在熔化或凝固時吸收或放出大量潛熱而溫度幾乎不變。
相變材料的蓄熱量大，所以充熱和放熱的速度也一定很快。
蓄熱槽裡的熱量只看總量，溫度分布不重要。
optionsEn: Substances absorb or release a large latent heat on melting or freezing with almost no temperature change.
Phase-change materials store a lot of heat, so they must charge and discharge quickly too.
Only the total heat in a storage tank matters, not its temperature distribution.
quiz.explanation: 物質在熔化或凝固時吸收或放出大量潛熱而溫度幾乎不變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Substances absorb or release a large latent heat on melting or freezing with almost no temperature change. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潛熱蓄能：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Latent heat storage: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「潛熱蓄能」如何決定「冰水蓄冷與尖峰負載移轉」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Latent heat storage” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Ice Thermal Storage and Peak Load Shifting”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 物質在熔化或凝固時吸收或放出大量潛熱而溫度幾乎不變。冰的熔化潛熱約為每公斤 334 千焦，相當於把同樣重的水加熱 80 °C，所以用冰蓄冷的體積只有冰水蓄冷的幾分之一；石蠟、鹽水合物等相變材料則可依熔點用於建築調溫或製程蓄熱。潛熱蓄能的難點在熱傳：固態相變材料的導熱差，充放熱功率受限，必須以鰭片、封裝或複合高導熱材料改善。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Substances absorb or release a large latent heat on melting or freezing with almost no temperature change. The latent heat of ice, about 334 kJ/kg, equals heating the same mass of water by 80 °C, so ice storage needs a fraction of the volume of chilled-water storage; paraffins and salt hydrates serve building temperature control or process heat according to melting point. The difficulty is heat transfer: solid phase-change material conducts poorly, limiting charge and discharge power, so fins, encapsulation or conductive composites are needed. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：地下室設有 44 座儲冰槽
steps.observationEn: Project file: The basement holds 44 ice storage tanks
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相變材料的蓄熱量大，所以充熱和放熱的速度也一定很快。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Phase-change materials store a lot of heat, so they must charge and discharge quickly too." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「潛熱蓄能」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Latent heat storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The latent heat of ice, about 334 kJ/kg, equals heating the same mass of water by 80 °C, so ice storage needs a fraction of the volume of chilled-water storage; paraffins and salt hydrates serve building temperature control or process heat according to melting point. The difficulty is heat transfer: solid phase-change material conducts poorly, limiting charge and discharge power, so fins, encapsulation or conductive composites are needed.

quiz.question: 依「潛熱蓄能」的模型 Q = m·L / 3600，相變材料完全熔化或凝固時的潛熱蓄能量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q = m·L / 3600 for "Latent heat storage", which value is closest to the latent heat stored when the phase-change mass melts or freezes completely?
options: 12.5 MWh
25.1 MWh
250 MWh
optionsEn: 12.5 MWh
25.1 MWh
250 MWh
quiz.explanation: Q = m·L / 3600；代入 ml = 270 t、Lh = 334 kJ/kg，得 25.1 MWh（相變材料完全熔化或凝固時的潛熱蓄能量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = m·L / 3600; with ml = 270 t, Lh = 334 kJ/kg the result is 25.1 MWh (latent heat stored when the phase-change mass melts or freezes completely). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 潛熱蓄能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Latent heat storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潛熱蓄能」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Latent heat storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = m·L / 3600；代入 ml = 270 t、Lh = 334 kJ/kg，得 25.1 MWh（相變材料完全熔化或凝固時的潛熱蓄能量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 ml 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = m·L / 3600; with ml = 270 t, Lh = 334 kJ/kg the result is 25.1 MWh (latent heat stored when the phase-change mass melts or freezes completely). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise ml by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：ml 增加 10% 時，結果變為 27.6 MWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising ml by 10% changes the result to 27.6 MWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 25.1 MWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 ml 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 25.1 MWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in ml with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q = m·L / 3600；代入 ml = 270 t、Lh = 334 kJ/kg，得 25.1 MWh（相變材料完全熔化或凝固時的潛熱蓄能量）。
knowledge.textEn: Q = m·L / 3600; with ml = 270 t, Lh = 334 kJ/kg the result is 25.1 MWh (latent heat stored when the phase-change mass melts or freezes completely).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: ml 增加 10% 時，結果變為 27.6 MWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising ml by 10% changes the result to 27.6 MWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潛熱蓄能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Latent heat storage"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
所有的東西凝固時都會收縮。
以充放循環量測載熱流體的流量與進出口溫度，求得實際蓄能量與充放功率曲線；相變材料樣品以差示掃描量熱儀（DSC）量測熔點與潛熱。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Everything shrinks when it solidifies.

Measure heat-transfer-fluid flow and inlet and outlet temperature through charge-discharge cycles for actual stored energy and power curves, and measure melting point and latent heat of material samples by differential scanning calorimetry.
quiz.explanation: 以充放循環量測載熱流體的流量與進出口溫度，求得實際蓄能量與充放功率曲線；相變材料樣品以差示掃描量熱儀（DSC）量測熔點與潛熱。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure heat-transfer-fluid flow and inlet and outlet temperature through charge-discharge cycles for actual stored energy and power curves, and measure melting point and latent heat of material samples by differential scanning calorimetry. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潛熱蓄能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Latent heat storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潛熱蓄能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Latent heat storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以充放循環量測載熱流體的流量與進出口溫度，求得實際蓄能量與充放功率曲線；相變材料樣品以差示掃描量熱儀（DSC）量測熔點與潛熱。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure heat-transfer-fluid flow and inlet and outlet temperature through charge-discharge cycles for actual stored energy and power curves, and measure melting point and latent heat of material samples by differential scanning calorimetry. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：材料選用要附數千次循環後的潛熱與熔點穩定性數據，設計須同時滿足蓄能量與充放功率兩項需求。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Material selection should come with latent-heat and melting-point stability data after thousands of cycles, and design must meet both energy and power requirements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鹽水合物在反覆循環後發生相分離與過冷，潛熱逐漸降低；熔化時約一成的體積變化若未預留空間，會使封裝容器破裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Salt hydrates segregate and supercool after repeated cycling and lose latent heat, and a volume change of about a tenth on melting ruptures the encapsulation if no space is allowed. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure heat-transfer-fluid flow and inlet and outlet temperature through charge-discharge cycles for actual stored energy and power curves, and measure melting point and latent heat of material samples by differential scanning calorimetry.

quiz.questionEn: When "Latent heat storage" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 鹽水合物在反覆循環後發生相分離與過冷，潛熱逐漸降低；熔化時約一成的體積變化若未預留空間，會使封裝容器破裂。

Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.

steps.title: 潛熱蓄能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Latent heat storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潛熱蓄能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Latent heat storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鹽水合物在反覆循環後發生相分離與過冷，潛熱逐漸降低；熔化時約一成的體積變化若未預留空間，會使封裝容器破裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「冰水蓄冷與尖峰負載移轉」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Salt hydrates segregate and supercool after repeated cycling and lose latent heat, and a volume change of about a tenth on melting ruptures the encapsulation if no space is allowed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Ice Thermal Storage and Peak Load Shifting”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：潛熱蓄能的難點在熱傳：固態相變材料的導熱差，充放熱功率受限，必須以鰭片、封裝或複合高導熱材料改善。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相變材料的蓄熱量大，所以充熱和放熱的速度也一定很快。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Phase-change materials store a lot of heat, so they must charge and discharge quickly too." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 關於「顯熱蓄熱量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sensible heat storage" is correct?
options: 蓄熱槽裡的熱量只看總量，溫度分布不重要。
同一台冷凍機，不論做什麼溫度，效率都一樣。
最簡單的蓄熱方式是讓水、岩石或土壤升溫。
optionsEn: Only the total heat in a storage tank matters, not its temperature distribution.
One chiller is equally efficient whatever temperature it makes.
The simplest heat store warms water, rock or soil.
quiz.explanation: 最簡單的蓄熱方式是讓水、岩石或土壤升溫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The simplest heat store warms water, rock or soil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 顯熱蓄熱量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Sensible heat storage: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「顯熱蓄熱量」如何決定「冰水蓄冷與尖峰負載移轉」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sensible heat storage” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Ice Thermal Storage and Peak Load Shifting”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 最簡單的蓄熱方式是讓水、岩石或土壤升溫。儲存的熱量等於質量、比熱與溫差的乘積；水的比熱在常見材料中最高，又便宜無毒，所以從家用熱水槽到數萬立方公尺的區域供熱蓄熱槽都用水。大型蓄熱體的表面積對體積比小，熱損比例低，甚至可以把夏天的太陽熱存到冬天使用，稱為季節性蓄熱。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The simplest heat store warms water, rock or soil. Stored heat is mass times specific heat times temperature change; water has the highest specific heat of common materials and is cheap and non-toxic, so it serves from domestic cylinders to district-heating tanks of tens of thousands of cubic metres. A large store has a small surface-to-volume ratio and low relative loss, and can even carry summer solar heat into winter as seasonal storage. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：大樓於 2009 年完工
steps.observationEn: Project file: The building was completed in 2009

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Only the total heat in a storage tank matters, not its temperature distribution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.textEn: The simplest heat store warms water, rock or soil. Stored heat is mass times specific heat times temperature change; water has the highest specific heat of common materials and is cheap and non-toxic, so it serves from domestic cylinders to district-heating tanks of tens of thousands of cubic metres. A large store has a small surface-to-volume ratio and low relative loss, and can even carry summer solar heat into winter as seasonal storage.

quiz.question: 依「顯熱蓄熱量」的模型 Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600，水體升溫 ΔT 所儲存的熱量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600 for "Sensible heat storage", which value is closest to the heat stored by warming the water volume through ΔT?
options: 24 MWh
244 MWh
12.2 MWh
optionsEn: 24 MWh
244 MWh
12.2 MWh
quiz.explanation: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600；代入 Vs = 3000 m³、cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K)、dTs = 7 K，得 24 MWh（水體升溫 ΔT 所儲存的熱量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600; with Vs = 3000 m³, cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K), dTs = 7 K the result is 24 MWh (heat stored by warming the water volume through ΔT). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 顯熱蓄熱量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sensible heat storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「顯熱蓄熱量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Sensible heat storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600；代入 Vs = 3000 m³、cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K)、dTs = 7 K，得 24 MWh（水體升溫 ΔT 所儲存的熱量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 dTs 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600; with Vs = 3000 m³, cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K), dTs = 7 K the result is 24 MWh (heat stored by warming the water volume through ΔT). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise dTs by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：dTs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 27 MWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising dTs by 10% changes the result to 27 MWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 24 MWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 dTs 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 24 MWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in dTs with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600；代入 Vs = 3000 m³、cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K)、dTs = 7 K，得 24 MWh（水體升溫 ΔT 所儲存的熱量）。
knowledge.textEn: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600; with Vs = 3000 m³, cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K), dTs = 7 K the result is 24 MWh (heat stored by warming the water volume through ΔT).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: dTs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 27 MWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising dTs by 10% changes the result to 27 MWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「顯熱蓄熱量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sensible heat storage"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以蓄熱體內多層溫度感測器求平均溫度與分層情形，配合充放熱迴路的熱量表做能量平衡，計算一個週期的蓄熱效率。
儲冰可以節省能源。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.

Use multi-level temperature sensors in the store for mean temperature and stratification, and balance energy with heat meters on the charge and discharge circuits to compute storage efficiency over a cycle.
Ice storage reduces total energy use.
quiz.explanation: 以蓄熱體內多層溫度感測器求平均溫度與分層情形，配合充放熱迴路的熱量表做能量平衡，計算一個週期的蓄熱效率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use multi-level temperature sensors in the store for mean temperature and stratification, and balance energy with heat meters on the charge and discharge circuits to compute storage efficiency over a cycle. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 顯熱蓄熱量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sensible heat storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「顯熱蓄熱量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sensible heat storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以蓄熱體內多層溫度感測器求平均溫度與分層情形，配合充放熱迴路的熱量表做能量平衡，計算一個週期的蓄熱效率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use multi-level temperature sensors in the store for mean temperature and stratification, and balance energy with heat meters on the charge and discharge circuits to compute storage efficiency over a cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：蓄熱系統要以「可用溫度以上的熱量」而非總熱量評估性能，並把分層品質列入驗收量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assess a heat store by heat above the useful temperature rather than total heat, and include stratification quality in acceptance measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：進水擴散器設計不良使冷熱水混合、分層被破壞，雖然總熱量沒有少，可用的高溫熱卻減少，熱泵或鍋爐被迫提早啟動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification; total heat is unchanged but useful high-temperature heat is reduced and the heat pump or boiler starts early. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以蓄熱體內多層溫度感測器求平均溫度與分層情形，配合充放熱迴路的熱量表做能量平衡，計算一個週期的蓄熱效率。
knowledge.textEn: Use multi-level temperature sensors in the store for mean temperature and stratification, and balance energy with heat meters on the charge and discharge circuits to compute storage efficiency over a cycle.

knowledge.textEn: Assess a heat store by heat above the useful temperature rather than total heat, and include stratification quality in acceptance measurement.

knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ASME PTC 53 機械與熱能儲存系統性能試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。

quiz.question: 在「顯熱蓄熱量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sensible heat storage" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
同一台冷凍機，不論做什麼溫度，效率都一樣。

optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
One chiller is equally efficient whatever temperature it makes.
Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification.
quiz.explanation: 進水擴散器設計不良使冷熱水混合、分層被破壞，雖然總熱量沒有少，可用的高溫熱卻減少，熱泵或鍋爐被迫提早啟動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification; total heat is unchanged but useful high-temperature heat is reduced and the heat pump or boiler starts early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 顯熱蓄熱量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sensible heat storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「顯熱蓄熱量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Sensible heat storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 進水擴散器設計不良使冷熱水混合、分層被破壞，雖然總熱量沒有少，可用的高溫熱卻減少，熱泵或鍋爐被迫提早啟動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「冰水蓄冷與尖峰負載移轉」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification; total heat is unchanged but useful high-temperature heat is reduced and the heat pump or boiler starts early. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Ice Thermal Storage and Peak Load Shifting”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大型蓄熱體的表面積對體積比小，熱損比例低，甚至可以把夏天的太陽熱存到冬天使用，稱為季節性蓄熱。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A large store has a small surface-to-volume ratio and low relative loss, and can even carry summer solar heat into winter as seasonal storage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「蓄熱槽裡的熱量只看總量，溫度分布不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Only the total heat in a storage tank matters, not its temperature distribution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification; total heat is unchanged but useful high-temperature heat is reduced and the heat pump or boiler starts early.
